brief:
Turkey's Foreign Ministry rejected accusations targeting President Recep Tayyip Erdogan on Saturday, characterizing them as reflections of "cowardly and corrupt mentality" among Israeli government officials, particularly Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry issued the statement in response to what it described as lies and false claims directed at the Turkish leader.

The Foreign Ministry did not elaborate on which specific allegations it was addressing in its rebuke. The statement framed the accusations as part of a broader pattern of attacks emanating from Israel's political leadership against Erdogan and Turkish interests. Turkish officials have repeatedly clashed with Israel over its military operations in Gaza and its treatment of Palestinians.

title: Turkey condemns Israeli allegations against Erdogan as cowardly propaganda
